items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 20:1
items.html:
(To the question) Gadlut (greatness)
Mochin of Aba, that is, illumination of Hochma, is called Gadlut. See Item 19.
